info.name: SIMOSphere AI Copilot Mini
info.summary: Ask your Nextcloud documentation in natural language — with sources.
info.description:
Copilot Mini is a free, open-source assistant for the **Nextcloud documentation**. It searches the official admin, user and developer manuals locally (a prebuilt, multilingual semantic index ships with the app) and lets a language model of *your* choice phrase the answer — every reply links back to the exact documentation page.
- **Bring your own key** — OpenAI, Anthropic or a local Ollama model. Nothing is sent to any SIMO server; the app is fully self-contained. - **Sourced answers** — every reply cites the docs.nextcloud.com page it is based on. - **Privacy-first** — the knowledge base ships with the app; only your question and the retrieved snippets go to the LLM provider you configured.
Copilot Mini is the free little sibling of **SIMOSphere AI Copilot**, which brings the same assistant to your own data — files, mail, ERP and more. See https://www.simo-online.com.
